title: The Cooling Vent of Obsidrenn
story: Deep in the volcano's throat, Obsidrenn the Vent Whisper has sealed the miners behind a glowing heat-gate. The gate's heat is 640 degrees of ember-measure and it cools by half every 15 minutes — but the miners can only slip through once it drops below 45 degrees. Mr 6 sits on a cool rock and does the thinking before the waiting.
question: How many minutes must Mr 6 wait before the gate's heat first drops below 45 degrees of ember-measure?
solution: Halve step by step: 640 -> 320 (15 min) -> 160 (30 min) -> 80 (45 min) -> 40 (60 min).
40 is the first value below 45, and it arrives after 4 halvings.
praise: Repeated halving was the perfect tool — the trick was checking that 80 is still above 45, so one more halving was needed.
hint: Write the heat after each 15 minutes and stop the moment the number is under 45.
victory: At minute 60 the gate dimmed to a friendly orange and the miners strolled out. Obsidrenn sighed, 'Nobody ever waits me out,' and puffed off to warm somebody's soup.
imagePrompt: A shimmering heat-spirit of red vapor guarding a glowing stone gate inside a volcanic shaft, trapped miners waiting in the smoky orange gloom while a small numeral-6 knight counts on his fingers.
